title: Dye Trader trade and Strange Plants in world generation (GenVersion bump)
player_outcome: Strange Plants now grow rarely on grass and in caves. Bring one to the Dye Trader, and 'Trade' swaps it for a rare dye.
design: World generation: 4 natural tile objects strange_plant_1..4, each dropping its own item. Place them in DecorationPass through DecorPalette.cs: about 1 per 2000 grass-top columns on the surface and in underground jungle/grass, deterministic via SeedTree names, with no transcendental maths.

Bump GenVersion.Current to the next value and add a comment. Re-record the 6 golden hashes in tests/Strata.Core.Tests/WorldGen/WorldGenTests.cs and update Assert.Equal(version) there. Old worlds are disposable.

A new 'dyeTrade' service {acceptsTag:'strange_plant', table:'dye_trader_trade'}. TownServices.DyeTrader.cs has TradeStrangePlant(npc, player, out ItemStack dye): it removes one tagged item from the backpack and rolls the loot table into the backpack.

Items: strange_plant_1..4 (tag strange_plant, material) and rare dyes for the trade table (acid, red_acid, blue_acid, mushroom, purple_ooze, reflective, gel, negative, shadow...: about 8 new dye items). The TownDialog.Services entry 'dyeTrade' shows 'Trade' only when a plant is carried.
ItemSources (P5-24) lists the strange plants as world-generated through the objects' Natural flag.
